name: Donor Wall - Filtered To One Giving Level
description: The chips actually in use, which a resting capture cannot show. One giving level is selected: its band stays, the others hide with their donors rather than leaving headings over empty rows, and the chosen chip reads as pressed so a screen-reader user is told which filter is active instead of inferring it from what disappeared. Nothing was removed from the page to achieve this — every donor is still in the HTML, which is why the wall is complete with JavaScript off.
